Viktor|adc.identity: Area magic damage mage. Glorious Evolution (passive): every unit killed gives him Hex Fragments (more for big minions, epic monsters and champions); every 100 fragments, he permanently augments an ability. Siphon Power (Q) damages a target, gives him a shield and empowers his next attack, Gravity Field (W) slows in an area, then stuns enemies who stay inside, Hextech Ray (E) fires a laser in a line, and Arcane Storm (R) creates a steerable storm that deals continuous damage and interrupts channels.
Viktor|adc.playstyle: Zone control mage played like a carry: he clears waves with his laser, pokes and dominates teamfights.
Viktor|adc.early_game: Poke with Hextech Ray (E) by hitting both your opponent and the wave. Last hit for fragments: your first augment (often E) comes sooner if you farm well. Save Gravity Field (W) against engages.
Viktor|adc.level_1: Siphon Power (Q) first. Many players even delay their ultimate to level 7 to level E; others take it at level 6.
Viktor|adc.level_2: Hextech Ray (E). Your main poke and wave clear tool: aim at your opponent through the wave.
Viktor|adc.level_3: Gravity Field (W). Your defense: drop it under a diver or under the opponent your support rooted to stun them.
Viktor|adc.level_6: Arcane Storm (at level 6 or 7, your choice): a steerable storm that deals continuous damage and interrupts channels. Combo: W → R → E → Q.
power_spikes: First augment (often E): a much stronger laser.
First completed item: wave clear and poke.
All augments unlocked: a dominant zone mage.
Viktor|adc.lane_plan: Control the wave with E, poke and last hit for fragments. Save W against engages. The ADC role quest (300 gold, more gold per kill and per minion, then an extra item slot) adds to your scaling. Join dragons: your laser and storm control the area.
Viktor|adc.trading: Short trade: Q → empowered attack → step back. Long trade: E → Q → attack. All-in: W → R → E → Q. Give up on it against bot lane mages who lock you down (Veigar).
threats: Engage supports when W is on cooldown.
Assassins who jump on you: you have no dash.
mistakes: Wasting W on poke and having no defense left.
Missing last hits and delaying your augments.
Casting the storm far from enemies instead of steering it onto them.

matchup_notes.Kai'Sa: Drop W under yourself when she dives with her ultimate.
matchup_notes.Jinx: She scales too: win teamfights with your storm.
matchup_notes.Caitlyn: Poke her with E through the wave.
matchup_notes.Ezreal: He dodges with E: cast W where he lands.
matchup_notes.Veigar: Don't walk through his cage: poke him with E from afar.

Viktor|adc.mid_game: Clear waves with E, join objectives and control the area with W and R.
Viktor|adc.late_game: Stay behind your frontline, poke with E, drop W on divers and steer the storm onto the enemy group.
Viktor|adc.ahead: Force teamfights around objectives: your augmented storm grows with every takedown.
Viktor|adc.behind: Clear waves safely and reach your augments.
Viktor|adc.win_condition: To win this game, you want to get your augments by farming, then dominate teamfights with your laser and your storm.
Viktor|adc.final_tip: Every last hit counts toward your augments: don't neglect farming, even in bot lane.
